mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in transferring my insurance agency/book of business to Renegade?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The process has four steps:
1. Renegade signs an NDA and issues a Letter of Intent.
2. Renegade requests a due diligence package including 12 months of commission statements, bank statements, production reports, loss ratio reports, a full policy list, carrier contact details, your active license, and current appointment status.
3. Once due diligence is complete, Renegade issues a contract for signing.
4. After signing, Renegade transfers payment and takes ownership of the book.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to transfer an insurance agency/book of business with Renegade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most book transfers complete in 30 to 120 days from contract signing. The timeline depends on carrier requirements and administrative procedures. Renegade works to expedite the process while ensuring a smooth transition for all parties.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my clients/customers after I transfer my insurance agency/book of business?

acceptedAnswer.text: All clients transfer to Renegade, where the service team manages renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and cross-sells. Coverage continuity is maintained throughout the transition. Clients experience no gap in service.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to use a broker to sell my insurance agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Renegade buys directly from agency owners with no broker involvement. There are no broker fees at any stage of the transaction.

mainEntity.name: What if I'm not ready to sell my agency yet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renegade offers a Back Office Support partnership for agency owners who want to reduce operational load without a full exit. Partners retain their book while Renegade handles servicing, back-office, and carrier access.
